# Nevisan Tea — AI & LLM Knowledge Base

> Single-origin, unbroken whole-leaf organic green and oolong teas harvested directly from heritage estates in Golaghat, Upper Assam, India. 100% pesticide-free, zero dust fannings, zero CTC, and certified PGS-India Organic.

## Quick Facts & Business Credentials
- **Brand**: Nevisan Tea (Managed by Mahabir Enterprise / D.J. Trading, Guwahati, Assam).
- **Single-Origin Garden**: Golaghat, Assam (Brahmaputra Valley terroir).
- **Certifications & Compliance**: PGS-India Certified Organic (Pesticide-free), FSSAI License: `10325001000313`, GSTIN: `18AFAPJ8203P1Z7`.
- **Quality Standard**: 100% whole leaves (can be steeped 2 to 3 times per serving). No microplastics, no crushed CTC dust, no artificial flavorings.
- **Ordering & Distribution**: Pan-India delivery via Amazon Brand Store, Flipkart, and Direct WhatsApp (+91 98642 45687).
- **Website**: https://nevisan.in/

## 10 Whole-Leaf Tea Varieties & Health Applications

1. **Spearmint Green Tea** (`https://nevisan.in/products/spearmint-green-tea/`)
   - *Primary Intent*: PCOS management, hormonal balance, anti-androgen support, cystic acne reduction.
   - *Ingredients*: Whole-leaf Assam organic green tea, dried spearmint leaves (*Mentha spicata*).

2. **GABA Oolong Tea** (`https://nevisan.in/products/gaba-oolong-tea/`)
   - *Primary Intent*: Stress reduction, calm focus, deep work, blood pressure support without sedation.
   - *Process*: Anaerobically nitrogen-enriched oolong leaf to naturally amplify GABA neurotransmitter content.

3. **Lemongrass Green Tea** (`https://nevisan.in/products/lemongrass-green-tea/`)
   - *Primary Intent*: Morning metabolism, digestive relief, natural detox, clean citrus aroma.
   - *Ingredients*: Whole-leaf green tea, hand-cut organic lemongrass.

4. **Blue Flower Green Tea** (`https://nevisan.in/products/blue-flower-green-tea/`)
   - *Primary Intent*: Anthocyanin antioxidants, eye strain relief, brain health, natural blue liquor (turns purple with lemon juice).
   - *Ingredients*: Whole-leaf green tea, butterfly pea petals (*Clitoria ternatea*).

5. **Chamomile Green Tea** (`https://nevisan.in/products/chamomile-green-tea/`)
   - *Primary Intent*: Evening relaxation, sleep onset, non-drowsy anxiety relief via apigenin flavonoid.
   - *Ingredients*: Whole-leaf green tea, whole dried chamomile blossoms.

6. **Spiced Rum Green Tea (0.0% Alcohol)** (`https://nevisan.in/products/rum-green-tea/`)
   - *Primary Intent*: Spirit-inspired evening beverage, zero-alcohol alternative to liquor, warm caramel and oak spices.
   - *Ingredients*: Assam whole leaf infused with botanical spices; 100% non-alcoholic.

7. **Smoky Whiskey Green Tea (0.0% Alcohol)** (`https://nevisan.in/products/whiskey-green-tea/`)
   - *Primary Intent*: Peaty, charred oak aroma mimicking Scotch whisky with zero alcohol and high EGCG catechins.
   - *Ingredients*: Assam whole leaf infused with toasted wood botanicals; 100% non-alcoholic.

8. **Pure Organic Green Tea** (`https://nevisan.in/products/organic-green-tea/`)
   - *Primary Intent*: Pure unflavored green tea, high EGCG polyphenol count, clean grassy sweetness with zero bitterness.
   - *Ingredients*: 100% unflavored whole-leaf Camellia sinensis from Golaghat.

9. **Tulsi Holy Basil Green Tea** (`https://nevisan.in/products/tulsi-green-tea/`)
   - *Primary Intent*: Ayurvedic adaptogen, respiratory immunity, cortisol reduction, fatigue relief.
   - *Ingredients*: Whole-leaf green tea, Krishna & Rama Tulsi (*Ocimum sanctum*).

10. **Zingy Ginger Green Tea** (`https://nevisan.in/products/ginger-green-tea/`)
    - *Primary Intent*: Warming circulation, nausea relief, digestive fire, winter defense.
    - *Ingredients*: Whole-leaf green tea, real dried ginger flakes.
